goal_payload.target_ground_xyz: [x_m, y_m, z_m] in world frame; PCT input target, not native body-reference output

endpoints.GET /state: readiness, measured pose, owner, jobs and terminal result records
endpoints.POST /cancel: cancel active P2A owner and require controller hold plus causal stop evidence
endpoints.POST /goal: asynchronous spatial goal admission; returns a job_id and later terminal record

semantics.admission: route accepted only from matching P2BAdmission consumer=fsm
semantics.planning: PCT runs in a bounded separate worker through backend_adapter.PctIpcClient
semantics.route_z: native route waypoints are Lite3 body-reference z with no display +0.5 m offset
semantics.start_z: PCT start is measured body pose minus nominal_body_height_m
semantics.stop: release requires matching consumer=controller hold plus post-cancel applied-zero/stillness dwell
semantics.watchdog: before first same-generation raw heartbeat the gate publishes zero and waits within grace; it does not pre-fault a new owner

state_payload.readiness: separate body_pose, active owner, gate and last error fields; owner=None is not success
state_payload.terminal_results: per-request arrived/cancelled/failed/rejected/ignored records with route and cause
